          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVIII La Lune (The Moon)</span><p class="sp-r">La Lune&#x27;s dogs call up into the night and the night calls back, like the wood that keeps answering.</p></div>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">6</span><p class="sp-r">Ante Acum sums to 24, which reduces to 6: care and duty, the waiting before the needle while the skin is still whole.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">II La Papesse (The Popess)</span><p class="sp-r">La Papesse sits with her book open and unread: the ink is ready, the shield not yet written.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVII L&#x27;Étoile (The Star)</span><p class="sp-r">L&#x27;Étoile kneels under silent stars while a bird sits in the tree: the answer moves in the branch, not the sky.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">VIII La Justice (Justice)</span><p class="sp-r">La Justice draws the edge with her sword; the line is closed and the night stays outside.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">8</span><p class="sp-r">Medullifax sums to 44, which reduces to 8: weight, the marrow that keeps a body standing.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">IIII L&#x27;Empereur (The Emperor)</span><p class="sp-r">L&#x27;Empereur is the frame under everything; this song breaks into the floor under the floor.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">7</span><p class="sp-r">Cordifract sums to 52, which reduces to 7: solitude, counting heartbeats alone in the dark.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">X La Roue de Fortune (The Wheel of Fortune)</span><p class="sp-r">La Roue de Fortune turns on its crank; the pulse is counted, lost and counted again.</p></div>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">4</span><p class="sp-r">Sepulcrux sums to 40, which reduces to 4: structure, a seal laid down and built to hold.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XIII (the nameless arcanum)</span><p class="sp-r">The nameless arcanum leaves a cleared black field behind it, a ground that is sealed and does not reopen.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">I Le Bateleur (The Magician)</span><p class="sp-r">The Conjurer is Le Bateleur, card I, at his table of cups, coins and a knife.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">9</span><p class="sp-r">Suspensus sums to 27, which reduces to 9: endings, a world seen whole from upside down.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XII Le Pendu (The Hanged Man)</span><p class="sp-r">Suspensus is Le Pendu, card XII, hanging by one foot and seeing the room turned round.</p></div>

      <div class="wrap">
        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">6</span><p class="sp-r">Stella sums to 15, which reduces to 6: care, a light that keeps reaching after it is gone.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVII L&#x27;Étoile (The Star)</span><p class="sp-r">Stella is L&#x27;Étoile, card XVII, pouring two jugs by the pond under eight stars.</p></div>
        </aside>

      <div class="wrap">
        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">6</span><p class="sp-r">Stultus sums to 15, which reduces to 6: love and duty, the fool who keeps walking because someone is watching.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">Le Mat (The Fool)</span><p class="sp-r">Stultus is Le Mat, the card without a number, a dog at his heel and the road running out.</p></div>

      <div class="wrap">
        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">8</span><p class="sp-r">Iudicium sums to 44, which reduces to 8: power, the note strong enough to lift every lid.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XX Le Jugement (Judgement)</span><p class="sp-r">Iudicium is Le Jugement, card XX: a trumpet from the clouds and figures rising from the ground.</p></div>

aria-hidden="true">Intro</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Arbor caesa est priusquam deus nomen haberet.</span></p><p class="ly-t">The tree was felled door,</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">faciem eius suffragiis legerunt.</span></p><p class="ly-t">they chose his face by vote.</p></div><div was dry</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">ante precationem.</span></p><p class="ly-t">before the prayer.</p></div><div class="ly-orn" Nullus angelus cecidit.</span></p><p class="ly-t">There was no thunder. No angel fell.</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Soli viri cum clavibus, unum tintinnabulum frigidum.</span></p><p class="ly-t">Only men with keys, one cold bell.</p></div><div class="ly-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span></div><div class="ly-sec"><p class="ly-label">Chorus</p><p class="ly-label ly-label-t" aria-hidden="true">Chorus</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Primus in orbe deos fecit timor.</span></p><p class="ly-t">Fear was the first to make gods in the world.</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Primus in orbe deos fecit timor.</span></p><p class="ly-t">Fear was the first to make gods in the world.</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Procumbite.       <div class="wrap">
        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">2</span><p class="sp-r">Aurum sums to 20, which reduces to 2: duality, gold for the soul and the soul for gold.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XV Le Diable (The Devil)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Diable stands over two small figures on loose ropes: the hunger for gold that holds them.</p></div>
        </aside>

(Iacimus.)</span></p><p class="ly-t">Throw. (We throw.)</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Vivat? (Vivat.)</span></p><p class="ly-t">Shall he live? (Let him live.)</p></div><div class="ly-row ly-fx"><p class="ly-o"><span class="ly-text" lang="la">Pereat? (Pereat.)</span></p><p class="ly-t">Shall he die?           <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">8</span><p class="sp-r">Deus Tacet sums to 26, which reduces to 8: weight, the heavy silence that answers every cry.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">VIIII L&#x27;Hermite (The Hermit)</span><p class="sp-r">L&#x27;Hermite searches with his lantern and finds only quiet: the silence is the answer.</p></div>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">11</span><p class="sp-r">Corona Manet sums to 47, which reduces to 11, a master number kept as it is: the clear sight that the crown outlasts the idol.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVI La Maison Dieu (The Tower)</span><p class="sp-r">La Maison Dieu shows the top struck off the tower; the statue falls but the crown stays.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XIIII Tempérance (Temperance)</span><p class="sp-r">Tempérance pours without a ripple; the chair and the room go still.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">5</span><p class="sp-r">The Dark Comes Close sums to 68, which reduces to 5: change, the night drawing near.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVIII La Lune (The Moon)</span><p class="sp-r">La Lune shows the path at night between two towers; the dark comes close and is plain to see.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">8</span><p class="sp-r">Down to the Great Green sums to 98, which reduces to 8: weight, the depth of the sea.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVII L&#x27;Étoile (The Star)</span><p class="sp-r">L&#x27;Étoile kneels at the water&#x27;s edge and pours into it; the song goes down to the sea.</p></div>
